items.title: Validate opportunity booking conversion (DH ground-truth test)
items.current_state: FA publishes 200+ opportunities; no validation whether they actually book or convert workers.
items.gap: Of published opportunities, what % actually book? What % get applications? What's timeline from posting to booking?
items.why_it_matters: Without validation, FA is research. With validation, FA becomes a working platform users can trust.
items.research_needed: DH (as beta customer) validates 20 FA opportunities: confirms dates, pay, venue contact. Measures: application rate, booking conversion, worker satisfaction.
items.notes: This is the core proof-of-concept for FA as a working platform.

items.title: Measure market data accuracy (ground-truth validation)
items.current_state: FA research is comprehensive but untested against real-world field data.
items.gap: Are FA opportunity dates correct? Are pay rates realistic? Are venue contacts accurate? Worker trust depends on data accuracy.
items.why_it_matters: One bad experience (outdated opportunity, wrong contact, wrong pay) kills user trust permanently.
items.research_needed: DH validates 30 FA opportunities over 60 days: spot-checks dates, calls venues, confirms pay rates, updates/flags bad data.

items.title: Map opportunity demand to CB learning pathways (FA ↔ CB alignment)
items.current_state: FA has 8-9 departments; CB has 5 pathways. No alignment mapping.
items.gap: Which CB pathways map to highest-demand FA opportunities? Are there unmet curriculum gaps?
items.why_it_matters: CB learner should see clear path: 'finish Lighting pathway → browse Lighting opportunities on FA.' Alignment validates both products.
items.research_needed: Rank FA opportunities by: booking frequency, pay, worker shortage. Compare to CB pathway emphasis. Identify gaps.

items.title: Measure user adoption and engagement (worker adoption)
items.current_state: FA research is complete; user adoption is hypothetical.
items.gap: How many workers are using FA? How often do they return? Do they book gigs through it? What's NPS/satisfaction?
items.why_it_matters: Without adoption, FA is research; with adoption, it's a working platform. Unlocks paid tier viability.
items.research_needed: Implement analytics: user signups, login frequency, opportunity clicks, application submissions, booking conversions. Measure monthly.

items.title: Validate B2B employer interest (market positioning for employers)
items.current_state: FA hypothesizes B2B employer tools (labor availability, demand forecasting). Not tested.
items.gap: Do employers/production companies care about FA's labor intelligence? Would they pay for it?
items.why_it_matters: B2B revenue could be higher-margin than B2C. Unblocks pricing model and growth strategy.
items.research_needed: Interview 10 production companies: 'Would you pay for labor availability + demand forecasting intelligence?' What price? What features?
